Closest precedents: [TedRec (2024)](https://arxiv.org/html/2402.18166v1) combines sequence-level text–ID contextual fusion with dual sigmoid gates over fused features and denoised ID features. [PIRSP (2021)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0952197621001962) gates item-sequence and review-sequence representations, although reviews are unavailable here. [DIF-SR (2022)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.11046) separates side-information attention to improve attention rank and gradient flexibility. These establish contextual semantic fusion and gating as prior art; this search found no verified exact precedent for gating an additive semantic residual specifically by agreement across multiple historical items. That narrower mechanism remains a potential distinction, not an established novelty claim.

Hard-threshold concerns have direct theoretical support: binary thresholds have zero derivative almost everywhere; multiplying a semantic branch by a zero gate also removes its recommendation gradient. [Bengio, Léonard and Courville (2013)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1308.3432) discuss stochastic estimators, smooth alternatives and straight-through estimators. Practical deductions: initialize soft gates away from saturation, warm up the semantic branch, consider a small gate floor, and measure gate activation and branch gradient norms. Fixed support thresholds need no gate gradient, but can still starve the encoder they mask.

Evidence specifically covering scratch-trained item-text encoders is limited: TedRec uses pretrained text representations, so its findings cannot establish scratch-training stability. Its similar-title discrimination problem motivates checking lexical shortcuts, but does not prove common-token causation. Proposed safeguards: training-corpus frequency weighting, boilerplate removal, shuffled-text and frequent-token ablations, and agreement measured across distinct history items. [VICReg](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.04906) provides general anti-collapse evidence through variance and covariance regularization; applying it here is an extrapolation. Monitor embedding variance, effective rank and unrelated-item cosine similarity alongside validation HR@10.
